name: French Dressing
siboNotes: Contains high fructose corn syrup or sugar which may feed bacterial overgrowth. Choose brands with simple ingredients and use sparingly.
preparationTips: Read labels carefully - avoid brands with high fructose corn syrup
Look for versions made with sugar or maple syrup instead
Make homemade with olive oil, vinegar, tomato paste, and allowed spices
Store opened bottles in refrigerator and shake well before use
alternatives: Olive oil and red wine vinegar
Homemade tomato-based dressing with garlic oil
nutritionalHighlights: Provides vitamin E from vegetable oils
Often fortified with small amounts of vitamins A and C
High in calories from oil and sugar content
